plotEn:
Frederick Wilson, an oil executive, leads an expedition using infrared imagery that reveals an undiscovered island permanently hidden by clouds. Wilson believes the island has a huge oil deposit. Jack Prescott, a primate paleontologist, sneaks onto the expedition's vessel and attempts to warn the team against traveling to the island, citing an ominous final message about "the roar of the greatest beast" from previous doomed explorers. Wilson orders Prescott locked up, assuming he is a spy for a rival corporation, but eventually hires him as the expedition's photographer. Prescott spots a raft that carries the beautiful Dwan, an aspiring actress who was aboard a director's yacht, which exploded. During the rest of the ship's voyage, Prescott and Dwan become attracted to each other.
On reaching the island, the team discovers a primitive tribe living within a gigantic wall built to protect them from a mysterious god known as Kong. The team finds a large oil deposit, but it is so low quality that it is unusable. Later, while Dwan is on the ship's raft, the natives kidnap her and take her back to the island, where they offer her as a sacrifice to Kong. The giant ape grabs Dwan from the altar and returns to the jungle.
Although an awesome and terrifying sight, Kong quickly becomes tamed by Dwan, whose rambling monologue calms and fascinates him. After falling into the mud while trying to escape, Kong takes Dwan to a waterfall to wash herself, and then uses great gusts of his breath
